video_style: Realistic documentary footage of an indoor facility in one uninterrupted continuous shot.
lighting: Cool, even overhead LED light with soft floor reflections and gentle shadows under the benches.
perspective_view: Static side view from the near wall at standing eye height, framing the whole travel lane from the rover on the left to the charging dock on the right.

subjects_lifecycle.subject_attribute: Small white four-wheeled rover with rubber tyres and a short black sensor mast.

init_frame_visual_description: A clean, modern robotics research lab seen from one side. Pale concrete floor with a painted yellow travel lane running left to right across the middle of the room. A small white four-wheeled rover with a black sensor mast is parked at the left end of the lane. Nobody is in the room. The space contains a wheeled rover about 0.6 m wide to the left in the foreground, a steel workbench about 2.4 m wide at the centre in the background, a charging dock about 0.8 m wide to the right in the foreground.

events.event_description: The rover pulls away and drives steadily along the yellow lane from left to right, its wheels turning, and slows to a stop in front of the charging dock.

contained_actions.action: <|Subject1|> drives along the yellow lane from left to right at a steady pace.
<|Subject1|> slows and stops in front of the charging dock.

quality.video_quality: Stable room geometry and object forms, resolved surface detail, natural motion blur only on fast movement.
